title: receptance-cusp-catastrophes: code and data for cusp-pair births organized by the linear driving-point receptance

creators.name: Sarkar, Kanchan
creators.affiliation: Institut fuer Theoretische Chemie, Universitaet Ulm, 89081 Ulm, Germany

notes: Funding: state of Baden-Wuerttemberg through bwHPC; German Research Foundation (DFG) grant INST 40/575-1 FUGG (bwForCluster JUSTUS 2); Dr. Barbara Mez-Starck Foundation.
description:
Solvers, numerical experiments, and data for locating cusp-pair births in a driven resonator network from its linear driving-point receptance alone.

For a passive linear network carrying one localized conservative cubic, the period-one cusp set lies on a fixed phase contour of the driving-point receptance G at the nonlinear coordinate: arg G = -150° for a hardening cubic, -30° for a softening one. Where that contour becomes tangent as a network parameter is varied, a cusp pair is born; the curvature of the contour there separates a gap-opening beaks birth from an isolated-loop lips birth.

Contents: multi-harmonic balance and pseudo-arclength continuation, Floquet stability, random-network ensembles (including a rebuild on the exact non-proportionally damped receptance), an inverse-design solver, and a coupled-mode/Josephson device check. reproduce.md maps every quantitative result to the script that regenerates it. Environment pinned in requirements.txt.
